title: KCP deployment_drain result (DESIGN.md §10.5, §11.6.1 assistant author/deploy family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for deployment_drain (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The deployment after drain (gap notes KG4/KG11).

rollout_policy.description: Deterministic rollout rule; open object pending durable_runtime_v1's deployment_update/rollout (K2) — gap note KG10.

assistantDeployment.description: AssistantDeployment projection, field names verbatim from the §10.5 record shape (project_id and activated_at optional there). Secret values never appear; the secret-binding set carries only broker profile names and secret versions (§10.5).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Lifecycle status token. DESIGN.md §10.5 names these status fields without pinning a value space; the bounded lowercase token pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
